purpose: Verified contract for representing evidence-backed party/property relationships across time.
graph_rule: A graph relationship is a structured representation of an independently supported relationship, not proof created by graph structure.
identity_rule: Party identity and property identity must be independently matched.
temporal_rule: Material relationships carry temporal scope where relevant.
interest_rule: Party roles are linked to specific property interests rather than generic ownership labels.
evidence_rule: Material relationships retain supporting evidence and legal basis where required.
privacy_rule: Public graph views expose only approved, necessary relationship information.
verification_boundary: The graph organizes verified relationships; it does not infer unsupported legal relationships.
